modules.name: app-shell
modules.summary: Next.js App Router root layout, global styles, Korean metadata, Vercel analytics, and app-wide toaster.

modules.name: document-review
modules.summary: Home route for document type selection, file upload, OpenAI review execution, local review result persistence, document history, and markdown result viewing.

modules.name: admin-config
modules.summary: Admin route for document types, common review items, and type-specific review item management.

modules.name: settings-api-key
modules.summary: Settings route for storing, masking, replacing, and deleting the browser-held OpenAI API key.

modules.name: client-storage
modules.summary: localStorage repositories for document types, review items, common items, documents, review results, API key, user id, defaults, import, and export.

modules.name: openai-review-client
modules.summary: Browser-side OpenAI integration using file text extraction, GPT review calls, response parsing, and API key validation helpers.

modules.name: export-import
modules.summary: JSON settings export/import and full backup/restore UI backed by localStorage serialization. Phase 4 added a version 1 single settings JSON serializer with language and nested document review items.

modules.name: seed-data
modules.summary: ITU-T and JTC 1 standards seed JSON files under public/data for draft and contribution document types plus common review items.

modules.name: seed-loader
modules.summary: Loads public/data standards seeds into localStorage on empty startup and provides admin reset-to-seed behavior.

modules.name: language-setting
modules.summary: Stores review output language under draftreviewr:language and injects ko/en language instructions into all review providers and legacy fallback.

modules.name: settings-serializer
modules.summary: Version 1 settings export/import serializer for document types with nested review items, common review items, and language, excluding API keys and review data.

modules.name: review-result-width
modules.summary: Wider review result dialog surface for reading standards review output.

modules.name: score-schema
modules.summary: ReviewResult supports optional 0-100 score values while preserving existing unscored localStorage data.

modules.name: llm-score-output
modules.summary: OpenAI, Grok, OpenRouter, Kimi, and legacy OpenAI fallback request SCORE output and parse completed responses into optional scores.

modules.name: score-storage-contract
modules.summary: Provider results, upload mapping, and reviewResultStorage.create() carry score?: number through to localStorage.

modules.name: score-display-ui
modules.summary: Review result dialog renders per-result score badges and an overall average score summary.

modules.name: prompt-edit-in-results
modules.summary: Review result dialog allows inline editing of review item prompts with immediate local state refresh.

modules.name: ui-foundation
modules.summary: shadcn/Radix UI component layer, hooks, and shared utility functions.

routes.summary: Document upload, review initiation, and review history surface.
Document type and review item administration surface.
OpenAI API key and client-side settings surface.

known_issues: claude.md appears to describe an older Supabase/API-route architecture and must not be treated as authoritative without verification.
README and UI copy mention GPT-4o and encrypted API-key storage, but the current implementation uses model gpt-5 and stores the API key directly in localStorage.
There is no dedicated test script in package.json; current AC relies on phase validation, typecheck, and Next production build.

phases/3-provider-model-ui/index.json still lists its steps as pending even though the top-level phase status, baseline, tag, and git history show phase 3 completed. Treat the phase 3 baseline and tag as authoritative unless a dedicated state-sync step is added.

history.summary: Mapped the existing DraftReviewr app into harness module boundaries, public contracts, integration points, and baseline handoff.
MVP hardened: default data loading fixed, review failure state handled, product copy aligned with implementation, verification tooling added (typecheck + build).
Add OpenRouter, Grok (xAI Responses API), Kimi LLM backends with streaming support for all providers.
Provider selection on upload, model dropdown from provider APIs, and reasoning toggle for OpenAI/Grok.
Added ITU-T/JTC 1 seed document types, seed loader/reset, review result language setting, single settings export/import JSON, and wider review result dialog.
Added optional review scores, provider SCORE parsing, score badges and average summary, and inline prompt editing in review results.

current_contract_summary.runtime: Next.js 15 App Router with React 19 and TypeScript, implemented as client-heavy pages without project-local API routes.
current_contract_summary.data_model: DocumentType, ReviewItem, CommonReviewItem, UserApiKey, Document, ReviewResult with optional score, ApiKeyInfo, LLMProviderConfig, and LLMModel in lib/types.ts.
current_contract_summary.storage: Browser localStorage keys under draftreviewr:* for document types, review items, common review items, documents, scored review results, legacy API key, user id, LLM configs, active provider, and review output language.
current_contract_summary.ai_integration: Browser fetch calls through lib/providers/*.ts for OpenAI, Grok, OpenRouter, and Kimi; legacy lib/openai-client.ts remains as fallback. Non-streaming review paths request and parse SCORE output.
current_contract_summary.import_export: Settings export/import uses version 1 single JSON with language, document_types[] containing nested review_items[], and common_review_items[]; API keys, documents, and review_results are excluded from settings import/export.
current_contract_summary.review_result_ui: DocumentReviewDialog shows score badges and average score when scores exist, and supports inline prompt editing for review items/common review items.
